images.prompt: Edit the supplied approved slim wood wall reference into ONE photorealistic image. Preserve ALL existing thin vertical battens, their slender 27x27mm square section and exact widths/depths, positions, spacing, upper and lower battens, concrete wall, window, perspective, camera, natural light and near-9:16 composition. Only ADD TWO horizontal short pieces of the EXACT SAME 27x27mm square softwood batten between upright pairs in two adjacent middle bays at about mid-wall height. They must be equally THIN as the vertical members: each horizontal's front face height equals the front face width of its adjacent upright after perspective. NEVER turn a horizontal into a broad board or blocking plank, no 2x4 or mixed sizes. Simple slender line-like crosspieces with square ends touching the uprights in believable butt joints, front faces flush with upright front faces; no floating or intersecting/overlapping lumber. Only localized two-bay addition, no whole-wall grid. No brackets, L angles, joist hangers, oversized bolts, diagonal braces, metal stud, plywood, OSB or plasterboard. No installed TV, shelves, furniture or load claim. No text, logo or watermark. This is illustrative localized backing, not proof of structural capacity.
